title: Verify a manually installed integration and record its verified state

tool.description: The plugin to verify and record, by its plugin-catalog id (@nx-archweave/integrations plugin-catalog.ts). The enum is kept equal to the catalog by a test.

target.description: The host environment to verify against. Hosts with a plugin adapter; today only 'claude-code'.

apply.description: Write the manifest entry (only if live verification succeeds). Without it (default) the generator performs the same live read-only verification and shows what would be recorded, writing nothing. Ignored when Nx's own --dry-run is set.
